//: One site. On the hosted platform this same shape lives in the platform bucket as accounts/sites/<siteId>.json, one per site.

site.name: REPLACE-ME
site.//nav: Masthead links, rendered in order. Empty array = no nav.
site.//podcast: Only used when a post has templateType "podcast".

//template: Which template renders this site. Leave "version" empty to track whatever the library has.
//theme: Token overrides for that template. Keys come from its template.json; run cli/theme.mjs to see them.
//taxonomy: Post categories offered in the admin and rendered as tags. Key -> label. Delete them all for an uncategorized site.
//storage: Where this site's bytes live. "buckets" gives the site its own buckets and IAM isolation (self-hosting). "prefix" puts it in shared buckets behind a shared distribution (the hosted platform).
//members: Who may edit this site. The first owner is also seeded by infra/seed-staging.mjs.
//deploy: Account-level deploy settings, shared by every site in this installation.

deploy.//platformBucket: Template library + accounts. Separate from every site's content buckets.
deploy.//legacy: infra/* still reads these; they mirror storage.* for the single-site case.

//hosted: The hosted platform's own apex. Self-hosters leave this out entirely -- it is only used by infra/provision-hosted-dns.mjs and the shared distribution.

hosted.//tenantPattern: Where a hosted site lives. One wildcard label -- <site>.quickieweb.com.
